name: AcousticMate
principles: S3D core must not depend on domains
reusable acoustic modules may live in S3D domains/acoustics
physics must not depend on rendering
rendering must not contain acoustic calculations
meters are the canonical physical unit
speaker count is not limited by architecture
frequency range selection is a first-class visualization control
speaker position changes update the acoustic visualization continuously

layerBoundaries.WebGUI: concept-free minimalist DOM construction and structural rendering
layerBoundaries.S3D/core: domain-independent structural 3D runtime, geometry, interaction and rendering
layerBoundaries.S3D/domains/acoustics: reusable instantiable acoustic structures and visualizations
layerBoundaries.AcousticMate: application-specific acoustic calculations, project state and orchestration
